title: OpenDEA Progress Scoring Band Set
description: ProgressScoringBand is a first-class scale component (CR-AM-09 §7): a model-specific classification rule identifying the range or conditions under which assessed progress conforms to a level. Bands belong to the scale and resolve to defined levels. Three band families are supported: numeric intervals (min/max/inclusivity → level), non-numeric conditions (e.g. governance_conformance = true AND automation_score ≥ 75 → L4), and multi-dimensional conditions (overall + dimension scores + mandatory criteria + evidence requirements). Scores never imply levels: bands may carry mandatory-criteria gates and the resolution rule (separate schema) determines the final attribution.

scale.description: The MaturityScale these bands resolve into (id + version). Every band's level must resolve within that scale (conformance-enforced).

bands.description: The band set, one or more per scale level. Bands are ordered by the level ordinal they resolve to.

level.description: The scale level id this band resolves to.

family.description: Band family (CR-AM-09 §7): numeric interval, non-numeric conditions, or multi-dimensional conditions.

numeric.description: Numeric interval over the model's native score domain (family=numeric).

conditions.description: Non-numeric conditions (family=non-numeric or multi-dimensional): indicator/operator/value triples ANDed together.

mandatory_criteria.description: Evaluation-model criterion ids that must be satisfied for this band — the score alone is never sufficient (CR-AM-09 §7).

evidence_requirements.description: Evidence required for this band (multi-dimensional family).
